descriptions.__do_global_ctors: libgcc2 __do_global_ctors: runs the static constructor list from last to first, counting entries first when the list starts with -1.
descriptions.__main: libgcc2 __main: runs __do_global_ctors once, guarded by a static flag.
descriptions.__ashldi3: libgcc2 __ashldi3: shifts a 64-bit integer left by b bits.
descriptions.__ashrdi3: libgcc2 __ashrdi3: shifts a signed 64-bit integer right arithmetically by b bits.
descriptions.__cmpdi2: libgcc2 __cmpdi2: compares two signed 64-bit integers, returning 0 (less), 1 (equal) or 2 (greater).
